Name: Wizard's Garden
Author: Fungidelight
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The mod will spawn farm crops on patches of diggable soil on Arrow Island in Cindersap Forest. As your friendship with Wizard grows, and you fulfill his requests, there will be better crops and more spawns.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install the latest versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Farm Type Manager.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download Wizard's Garden.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the WizardsGarden folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Discover the Wizard's forgotten garden in the Cindersap Forest.[/*]
[*]Forage seasonal crops growing naturally on the Arrow Island. [/*]
[*]Crop availability expands as your friendship with the Wizard grows and you fulfill his request.[/*]
[*]Four progression tiers unlock through a series of events and letters from the Wizard.[/*]
[*]Seasonal crop pools change throughout the year.[/*]
[*]Early tiers provide a small selection of humble crops, while later tiers grant access to more valuable produce.[/*]
[*]Spawn rates increase as new tiers are unlocked. [/*]
[*]Despite being farm crops, the produce is harvested as "forage" and therefore benefits from Foraging professions.
[spoiler]Botanist profession therefore lets players harvest iridium quality crops.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]Fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 using Farm Type Manager and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Safe to use both in new and existing saves.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Progression[/b][/size]
[b]Tier 0[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Available after entering Wizard's tower at 1 heart of friendship and reading his first letter.[/*]
[*]A small selection of basic crops occasionally appears in the forest.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]Tier 1[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Unlocked after visiting Wizard's tower at 3 hearts of friendship with the required item in the inventory.[/*]
[*]Additional spring, summer, and fall crops become available.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]Tier 2[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Unlocked after visiting Wizard's tower at 6 hearts of friendship with the required item in the inventory. [/*]
[*]Larger crop variety and increased spawn frequency.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]Tier 3[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Unlocked after visiting Wizard's tower at 10 hearts of friendship with the required item in the inventory. [/*]
[*]The Wizard's garden reaches its full potential, including rare and valuable crops.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Lore[/b][/size]
Long before he became the valley's resident wizard, Rasmodius experimented with magical agriculture. Though most traces of those efforts have faded, fragments of his old garden still survive in the forest. As you earn his trust, and supply him with the required reagents, he gradually shares its secrets with you, allowing more of the forgotten harvest to emerge from the land.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The mod requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and Farm Type Manager. [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild and EscaMMC for developing the frameworks to make this mod possible.[/color]
